title: Tuition Fees, Payment Schedules, and Financial Aid 2024-2025
source: University Bursar and Financial Affairs Office
content: Official Tuition & Fee Schedule: Full-time undergraduate tuition is $4,800 per semester for in-state residents and $11,200 per semester for out-of-state students. Graduate programs charge $650 per credit hour. Fall tuition payment deadline is August 15. Unpaid balances incur a 5% monthly late fee. Merit scholarships require maintaining a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.25.
